descriptions.O: Acme Record in one video: your company's record flows into Claude, ChatGPT and your workspace, and a deck is checked against the filed release before anyone presents it.
descriptions.K01: Ask Claude to check the Q3 deck against the filed release. One figure differs, the release's own sentence shows why, and one press puts the filed figure in and saves the deck for review.
descriptions.K02: In Acme Record's own dashboard, search for a figure and see every document that states it, each one checked against the filed release.
descriptions.K03: On a phone, the morning's one check that needs you, with the figure that differs and the release that settles it.

ask.title: See it on your own record
ask.text: We set Acme Record up on one quarter of your filings, and you run the same checks on your own deck.

footer: Fernhill Instruments and its figures are fictional. Claude is a trademark of Anthropic; ChatGPT is a trademark of OpenAI.
